stories.title: How a museum masterpiece’s life-size replica sparked rare US-China collaboration

en.title: How a museum masterpiece's life-size replica sparked rare US-China collaboration
en.summary: A life-size replica of a 14th century Yuan dynasty Buddhist artwork at the Metropolitan Museum of Art in New York has facilitated collaboration between the United States and China. The monumental wall artwork, measuring over 15 metres wide and 7.5 metres tall, depicts a Buddhist assembly and is housed in the museum's Chinese Buddhist art gallery.

stories.title: In AI, India’s choice needn’t be between a US leash or Chinese hook

en.title: In AI, India's choice needn't be between a US leash or Chinese hook
en.summary: India faces pressure regarding artificial intelligence policy from both the United States and China. American export controls temporarily restricted access to advanced AI models for foreign users, while Chinese leadership has offered AI cooperation at international summits, leaving India navigating competing technological influences.

stories.title: 9 dead, including children and pregnant woman, in shooting in Erie, Pennsylvania

en.title: 9 dead, including children and pregnant woman, in shooting in Erie, Pennsylvania
en.summary: A shooting in Erie, Pennsylvania resulted in nine deaths, including a pregnant woman and children. A 45-year-old man killed eight people, most of whom were relatives, before taking his own life.

stories.title: Isaias kills 4 in US, leaves 670,000 without power

en.title: Isaias kills 4 in US, leaves 670,000 without power
en.summary: Hurricane Isaias caused four deaths and left approximately 670,000 residents across Florida, Alabama, Georgia, and Mississippi without power after making landfall. The storm weakened to a post-tropical cyclone as it moved across the southeastern United States.

stories.title: Trump demands Ukraine get new president, lashes out at Zelensky

en.title: Trump demands Ukraine get new president, lashes out at Zelensky
en.summary: US President Donald Trump has called for Ukraine to replace President Volodymyr Zelensky, asserting that Zelensky has rejected multiple opportunities to negotiate an end to the war with Russia.

stories.title: Christa Pike out of hospital and back in prison after surviving US execution attempt

en.title: Christa Pike out of hospital and back in prison after surviving US execution attempt
en.summary: Christa Pike, a 50-year-old inmate who survived Tennessee's attempted lethal injection execution, has been discharged from the hospital and returned to the women's prison where she has been housed for 30 years.

stories.title: 郑钦文首进中网女单决赛 刷新中国选手赛会最佳单打战绩

en.title: Zheng Qinwen reaches China Open women's singles final for first time, sets best record for Chinese player at tournament
en.summary: Chinese tennis player Zheng Qinwen defeated Belgium's Elise Mertens 7-5, 6-2 in the women's singles semifinal to reach her first China Open final. She became the first player to reach the women's singles final on a wildcard and the first Chinese player to reach a singles final at the tournament.

stories.title: 外交部：暂无中国公民在巴拿马地震中伤亡报告

en.title: Foreign Ministry: No reports of Chinese citizens injured or killed in Panama earthquake
en.summary: A 7.6-magnitude earthquake struck Panama on October 10 with over 100 aftershocks recorded. China's Foreign Ministry reported no casualties among Chinese citizens and extended condolences to the Panamanian government and affected residents.

stories.title: Palestinian leader Abbas postpones elections to September 2027

en.title: Palestinian leader Abbas postpones elections to September 2027
en.summary: Palestinian President Mahmoud Abbas postponed legislative elections previously scheduled for next month to September 11, 2027, citing Israeli actions and security conditions as obstacles to holding fair elections.

en.title: Why can milk relieve spiciness? Why are light bulbs pear-shaped? Learn some popular science knowledge
en.summary: This article addresses common questions about everyday phenomena, explaining the science behind why milk alleviates the sensation of spicy food and the design reasons behind the distinctive pear shape of light bulbs.

en.summary: The Chinese Embassy in Saudi Arabia issued a consular alert on October 10th regarding frequent attacks on Riyadh Airport.

en.summary: Guangxi University established a modern papermaking industry technology research institute on October 10th aimed at advancing research innovation and developing the forest-pulp-paper sector.

en.title: Better protection needed as violent cryptocurrency robberies surge
en.summary: Cryptocurrency holders face increasing risks from violent crime targeting their digital assets. The industry should develop products and services that address physical safety concerns alongside asset protection.

stories.title: Gen Z overtakes older collectors as art market spending rebounds globally: report

en.title: Gen Z overtakes older collectors as art market spending rebounds globally: report
en.summary: Younger wealthy collectors are now the art market's largest spenders, with expenditure more than double that of older generations. The global art market rebounded to approximately US$60 billion, driven partly by continued growth in mainland China and Hong Kong.

stories.title: China wants 5 innovative drugs with US$1 billion returns by 2030. Which might they be?

en.title: China wants 5 innovative drugs with US$1 billion returns by 2030. Which might they be?
en.summary: China has set a target to develop at least five pharmaceutical products generating over US$1 billion in annual global sales by 2030, as the country seeks to establish itself as a major biomedical power and compete with Western drug makers.

stories.title: K&K offers extra warranty to One Stanley homebuyers amid building defects furore

en.title: K&K offers extra warranty to One Stanley homebuyers amid building defects furore
en.summary: Developer K&K Property announced a six-year structural warranty for homeowners at its One Stanley luxury development in response to concerns about construction defects at the complex.
